definition: Difficult, inconvenient, or not behaving as expected.
author: Marcus Aurelius
quote: The most weighty and serious, if rightly esteemed, but as puppies, biting one another: or untoward children, now laughing and then crying.
example_sentence: The flight landed without anything untoward happening.
